data.description:
## Context
Change 1855 patchset 2 CI run 32130591202, Ubuntu Python 3.12 job 95691543683, passed 13,821 tests and then errored in `test_ledger_attribution_is_unchanged_by_the_batching`. The fixture diagnostics added by prior bug `warmthless-dermal-oropendola` captured the first actionable recurrence: `git merge -q --no-edit side` failed rc=128 because blob `66842fd006b2fdc95ff55a33a263f1cb216bc7d6` referenced by `1005-cccc2222-COMMENT.json` was missing. `git fsck --full` reported the same missing blob; `.git/objects/pack/tmp_pack_53R4Hl` existed with size 0. The current Gerrit patch only changes the Anthropic test isolation subprocess and does not touch this fixture or Git object operations.

## Plan
Run the full chronic-issue rebar-debug protocol with independent code-tracer, historical, and empirical investigators. Reproduce or deterministically force the object-loss mechanism, discriminate concurrent Git maintenance/repack from fixture logic and filesystem/environment causes, record a proven runtime RCA, then design a held-out RED oracle at the real Git seam. Only after the cause is proven, implement the smallest class-level repair, verify RED→GREEN with exact-defect mutation, run the affected fixture under CI-parity xdist stress, and sweep sibling Git-fixture operations.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The exact missing-blob/tmp-pack failure is explained by a runtime-confirmed, cited mechanism.
- [ ] Competing fixture-content, hook, ref-resolution, environment, and filesystem hypotheses are explicitly confirmed or rejected.
- [ ] A held-out test deterministically fails through the real Git object-store seam before the repair and passes after it.
- [ ] Reintroducing the exact confirmed defect returns the held-out test to RED.
- [ ] The original authorship fixture passes under CI-parity xdist stress without weakening its ledger-attribution assertions.
- [ ] Sibling instances of the confirmed Git-operation pattern are swept and dispositioned.
- [ ] The final RCA, proof, scope/safety audit, and replication evidence are recorded on this ticket.
data.title: Authorship batching fixture loses Git blob during concurrent CI
